attributes.title: tag_query
attributes.description: Query a Tag Provider with a bounded semantic subset of system.tag.query. Supports native continuation without exposing the internal UDT definition namespace.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Tag Provider name. Required for a new query; omit or leave empty when continuing with a continuation token.

parameters.name: pathPattern
parameters.description: Optional Tag path pattern understood by system.tag.query, for example Area/*.

parameters.name: namePattern
parameters.description: Optional Tag name Like-pattern, for example *Pump*.

parameters.name: tagType
parameters.description: Optional tag type: AtomicTag, Folder, or UdtInstance. UDT definitions are handled by udt_type_* tools.

parameters.name: valueSource
parameters.description: Optional value source: memory, opc, expr, db, reference, or derived.

parameters.name: includeUdtMembers
parameters.description: Whether UDT members may appear. Default true.

parameters.name: returnProperties
parameters.description: Properties to return from the allowlist: path, name, tagType, dataType, valueSource, typeId, quality. path is always added internally.

parameters.name: maxResults
parameters.description: Maximum results in this page, 1..500. Default 100.

parameters.name: continuation
parameters.description: Opaque continuation token returned by a previous tag_query call. When supplied, the Gateway-stored query is continued.
